heading: Protection for declarants
lead: A declarant under this subchapter shall enjoy the protections of section 3059A(e) 1 of title 18.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 3059A(e) of title 18, referred to in text, was repealed by Pub. L. 107–273, div. A, title III, § 301(c)(2), Nov. 2, 2002, 116 Stat. 1781.
